description: Accessiboss alert settings of one site: who is told about new or returned issues. action get (default) or set (any of enabled, notifyInPortal, notifyEmail, recipients = email list up to 10, digest off/daily/weekly, minSeverity critical/serious/moderate/minor; confirm).

action.description: get is default. set needs confirm.

enabled.description: true turns it on, false off.

site.description: Accessiboss site: id, public key or domain. Optional when the account has one site.

name: oma_accessiboss_alerts
title: Accessiboss alerts
